externalReference.skipPolicy: If the sibling gozero checkout is unavailable, validate this contract without running oracle replay.

oraclePolicy.positioning: The oracle compares generated contracts against real goctl output without claiming byte-for-byte replacement.
oraclePolicy.generationPolicy: Each fixture is copied to a temporary source tree before goctl runs, because goctl may format or back up API input files.
oraclePolicy.failurePolicy: The report fails only when gofly generation fails or required contract evidence is missing; goctl layout differences remain classified evidence.

nextPromotionCriteria: Persist oracle reports as tracked reference evidence only after output shape stabilizes.
Promote model parity rows from layout-difference to same-contract only after MySQL DDL, datasource, PostgreSQL, and Mongo coverage exists.
Make goctl generation failures blocking only after the sibling gozero version is pinned in CI.
nativeFixturePolicy: At least one fixture must be accepted by real goctl so oracle replay can produce concrete contract diff categories, not only generation-error evidence.
